# V1 struct-only checkpoint fixture

This fixture is a reduced copy of
`kernel/tests/data/v1-single-part-struct-stats-only` from delta-kernel-rs
v0.25.0 (`723c9e3`). The upstream fixture was generated by Databricks Runtime
with `delta.checkpoint.writeStatsAsStruct=true` and
`delta.checkpoint.writeStatsAsJson=false`.

The Delta Kernel Rust project is Copyright 2023-2024 The Delta Kernel Rust
Authors and is licensed under Apache-2.0.

Only the version 5 checkpoint and `_last_checkpoint` hint are retained. The
commit log and data files are intentionally omitted because the regression test
validates provider scan planning without opening the active Parquet data files.
